fields.statement: Hands-on with built binaries at 58750e43 against a clone of this repo's real log (change set 01M71G4G92, whose pin entry 01M731FQPE is format 5), each with its own XDG_CACHE_HOME. I built four binaries: this branch and its merge-base b4130875, each at entry.FormatVersion 5 and patched to 4 (standing for the pre-#424 binary). Merge-base: the FV4 binary's rhiza change show 01M71G4G92 --json gives accepted with 6 problems ('entry out of order: after names 01M731FQPE9PY5EYQTA9H0C4CF...'), and the upgraded FV5 binary over that same index still gives accepted with 6 problems, twice, so the bug reproduces. This branch: FV4 gives the same 6 problems, then FV5 over the same index gives landed with 0 problems, and again on a second open. The index db's meta entry_format row reads 5 after that and user_version 6. Downgrading to FV4 rewrites it to 4 (6 problems again), and FV5 afterwards gives landed with 0 problems. A schema-5 index left by the merge-base binary, opened by this branch's FV5 binary, is rebuilt (user_version 6, entry_format 5) and folds landed. rhiza ready no longer lists 01M71G4G92. A warm open takes about 0.1s. go test -trimpath ./internal/index/... ok.
